_comment: Copy to roster.json (git-ignored) and replace with your real staff list. This is the single source of truth for display names, office and calendar routing. All people below are fictional.

leave_all_types.note: All leave types (AL/SL/BL/unpaid/other) go here. Calendar ID lives in config.json.

attendance.note: WFH + OOO go here regardless of office.

namingFormat.colonSpacing: Colon + one space, e.g. 'AL: Alex Chan'

types.AL: Annual / personal / day off / time off / unpaid
types.OOO: Out of office (usually an auto-reply) -> attendance calendar

namingFormat.mixedCase: One email with both leave and WFH -> one event on each calendar.

oooRule.evidenceBar: Lower than formal leave: the auto-reply comes from the person's own mailbox, so no approval trail is needed. Person + approximate dates is enough.
oooRule.dateInference: If only the return date is stated, use the auto-reply's own date as the start date and note it as inferred.
oooRule.phase2Impact: OOO never deducts any leave balance; calendar-only.

officeClassification.rule: Email listed with office=Malaysia below -> Malaysia; everyone else -> HK.

roster.note: Two people are called Alex: always use the surname

fallbackRule.description: Email not in roster[]: derive the display name from the email local part.
fallbackRule.algorithm: Split the local part on '.', '_' or digits, take the first segment, capitalize. jordan.li@example.com -> 'Jordan'; sam@partner.example -> 'Sam'.
fallbackRule.exceptions: If the local part is not name-like (random digits, run-together), use the first name from the Gmail display name.
